label: LOCAL ENGINEERING DRILL - pre-declared bound for the shared-lease fair-share re-run, written before any shared-lease A/B data existed
finding: O1 (congestion collapse above the knee); follow-up to fair-share-bound-declaration.json (declared 2026-10-11T16:07:10Z), whose bound every per-isolate on-arm run missed
change_under_test: admission state moved out of the edge worker into Postgres: one SECURITY DEFINER RPC acquires a lease (resolving the tenant from the presented key's SHA-256 in the same call, with an expiry so a killed worker cannot leak its slot) and one releases it; one admission scope shared by ingest and policy. Exact defaults are recorded with the results.
workload: unchanged from fair-share-bound-declaration.json: the 11-key knee profile, quiet tenant 1 key, noisy tenant 10 keys at the same per-key rate (noisy = 10x quiet), 2-event ingest batches, ingest:policy = 3:1, request timeout 10 s, max_in_flight 400, 90 s per run

arms.off: AIDR_TENANT_INFLIGHT_CAPACITY=10000 and AIDR_TENANT_INFLIGHT_MAX=10000 (limiter present but never binding; with the shared lease the off arm still makes the acquire and release round trips)
arms.on: kit defaults of the design under test (no AIDR_TENANT_INFLIGHT_* set)

order: per rate: off, on, off, on; 60 s cool-down between runs; edge runtime restarted to switch arms
control: quiet tenant alone at 56/11 = 5.09 rps for 90 s with the limiter on, same stack, measured before the A/B

bound_on_arm_quiet_tenant.p95_ms_max: min(241.2 ms, max(2 x new control p95, new control p95 + 150 ms))
bound_on_arm_quiet_tenant.p95_justification: 241.2 ms is the value the earlier declaration's formula produced from its control (p95 91.2 ms). The formula is re-applied to a fresh control on this stack because host capacity moved during the day, but the smaller of the two values is used, so the bound cannot loosen: neither a slower host nor the lease round trips themselves (which the new control includes) can raise it above 241.2 ms.
bound_on_arm_quiet_tenant.window: whole 90 s run, no warm-up exclusion

expected_on_arm_noisy_tenant: receives HTTP 429 tenant_overloaded with Retry-After (count > 0); informational only
latency_cost: the acquire and release RPC round trips are measured separately (sequential and concurrency 8) and reported whatever they show
pass_rule: every on-arm run at both rates meets every quiet-tenant bound. Any miss is reported as a miss, not re-run away. If the design is changed after a miss, the changed design runs the full A/B again against this same bound and every iteration is reported.
